note: Triennial election of Londonderry Corporation (aldermen and councillors), due Wednesday 21 May 1952: no contest. The twelve Unionist and eight Anti-Partition nominees were returned unopposed on nomination day, Wednesday 7 May (Derry Journal, 9 May 1952). The Journal's list gives the eight South Ward members as the Anti-Partition nominees and the North (8) and Waterside (4) members as the Unionist nominees. The two new Anti-Partition aldermen (Derry Journal, 7 May 1952). Returned unopposed.
